rationale: Review-13 frozen protocol locks optimizer_mode=bsam, budget_mode=fixed_updates with fixed_updates=69744 (= M0 seed43/bsam total trained epochs 24 x 2906 including its user-approved convergence extension), batch 128, lr 1e-4, order rule seed*101+epoch, StepLR(30,0.1) per completed epoch, BF16 autocast, FP32 losses/Adam, checkpoint rule minimum full-Validation Overall RMSE. These are byte-identical rules to the Review-12 bsam arms and their convergence extensions: same update function (run_fair.update, sha-verified), same model class/construction, same data pipeline. For M0 the MaskedModel wrapper is computationally transparent (mask_inputs passthrough, no hooks). The screen-stage M0 arm is Review-12 seed43/bsam plus its extension; M0 is not rerun. Ablation arms each train the same number of updates as M0 before selection.
